pack.name: EmpireDivers Forge
pack.notes: EmpireDivers r49 (v2.1): 496-UNIT armor/skinning/culling overhaul + JFO Snowtrooper/Sandtrooper/Commander/ISB/Vader upgrades + S2c EXO-49/51/55 AT-ST walkers + Imperial Lambda-class T-4a extraction shuttle, studio Fallen Order Purge/Stormtrooper voices + sealed 103 Armory previews (-21.5 LUFS) + optional Encrypted Death Trooper Slot 4 voice, green Star Destroyer vista/skybox turbolasers, 10-draw LEGO minifigure breakup gibs, cleaned US armor/weapon catalog, 3-way Bot & 3-way Squid selectors, and 5 performance tiers down to 256px + decimated meshes.
pack.statusNotes: Verified across all 5 tiers (full, lighter, reduced1024, reduced512, potato256) with 0 duplicate keys, 0 missing dependencies, 0 codec mismatches, and 139/139 runtime pins preserved.
